name: Perkasie
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Perkasie, PA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Perkasie and Sellersville, Pennsylvania for 2026: America's Oldest Tree Lighting, Winterfest and Festival of Trees.
lede: Perkasie claims the oldest community tree lighting in the nation, and neighboring Sellersville and the Pearl S. Buck House add a Winterfest and a Festival of Trees.
celebrates: Perkasie Borough's America's Oldest Tree Lighting is the main event, with school choirs, a drawing for the child who helps light the tree, a horse-drawn carriage, strolling carolers and the arrival of Santa on a borough electric truck. The Perkasie Model Railroad Club opens its train display, the Historic Carousel offers rides with Santa and the Historical Society shows a Christmas in Perkasie display. Sellersville Borough follows with Winterfest on Main Street, and the Pearl S. Buck House opens its Festival of Trees through January 3.
lastyear: Perkasie Borough says its ceremony began in 1909 and that 2026 marks its 118th year, which means 2025 was the 117th. The borough says it was officially recognized as the oldest in the United States in 2015, when it was read into the Congressional Record by Congressman Michael Fitzpatrick. We did not find a published recap of the 2025 evening, so the details above come from the borough's 2026 program.
facts: The borough's own electric utility is part of the show, since the borough says Santa and Mrs. Claus arrive on a Perkasie Electric truck. A local business blog notes that Perkasie's tree lighting still runs on the borough's own power. The Pearl S. Buck House, a National Historic Landmark on Dublin Road, sits on a 68-acre estate with a circa 1825 farmhouse and gardens, according to Visit Bucks County.
trains: The Perkasie Model Railroad Club opens its train display during the tree lighting weekend, and the borough lists it on Friday, December 4 and Saturday, December 5. For a real train, Santa's North Pole Express at New Hope Railroad runs from November 20 to December 30, 2026, according to Visit Bucks County, and the New Hope page on this site lists it.
train_links: The 1891 station and heritage railroad in New Hope, listed on our museum guide.
traditions: Perkasie has lit a community tree since 1909, according to the borough.
One child is chosen from a drawing at 6:30 pm, and a food donation for Pennridge FISH enters the drawing.
Santa on a Perkasie Electric Truck
Santa and Mrs. Claus arrive at 7 pm on a borough utility truck.
The carousel is open for rides with Santa before the lighting.
Trees and vignettes by Bucks County artists at the Pearl S. Buck House.
kidfact: One child from Perkasie gets picked from a drawing to help light the tree, and Santa arrives on a truck from the town's electric company.
faq: How old is the Perkasie tree lighting?
Perkasie Borough says its tree lighting began in 1909 and that 2026 is its 118th year. The borough says it was recognized as the nation's oldest in 2015.
When is the Perkasie tree lighting in 2026?
The borough lists Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 5 to 8 pm, with Santa arriving at 7 pm.
Can kids help light the tree in Perkasie?
Yes. The borough draws one child at 6:30 pm, and bringing a non-perishable food item for Pennridge FISH enters the drawing.
What else is there for kids near Perkasie?
Sellersville Winterfest on December 12 and the Pearl S. Buck House Festival of Trees, which Visit Bucks County lists through January 3, 2027.
